name: Achyuth KP
label: Software Engineer · Backend & AI
headline: Reliable systems. Useful AI.
tagline: Five years of backend engineering on a regulated banking platform, now applied to AI products that ship, verify, and hold up in production.
footnote: In production since Jul 2021 · Bengaluru, India · Open to opportunities

video.credit: A 60-second tour of my portfolio. Music: "Cinematic Minimal Orchestral Percussion Trailer" by Gregor Quendel, CC BY 4.0.

featured.title: Portfolio
featured.body: The site itself: one long scroll story with a WebGL particle portrait, a ⌘K menu, a working terminal, and hands-on demos of banking controls, including a maker-checker approval flow and an RFC 6238 TOTP generator.

featured.title: AegisAI
featured.body: A multi-tenant GenAI platform for banking operations: a compliance copilot that answers only from ingested documents with citations, Kafka-triggered dispute agents with human approval, an OAuth2-secured MCP server, PII and prompt-injection guardrails, and a sovereign mode with zero data egress.

featured.title: Kairo, an offline-first AI bank
featured.body: Mobile banking with an assistant that runs on the phone. It answers questions about your accounts, finds transactions by meaning, flags odd charges, and plans bills. Nothing is sent to a server; every feature works in airplane mode.

featured.title: VoxOs
featured.body: A native voice dictation and voice-to-action agent for the Mac. Speech is transcribed on the machine and turned into typing at the cursor, app focus, and shell commands. Audio never leaves the Mac.

more.title: ForgeFit
more.body: A fitness tracker with a coach you can talk to: three-tap logging, timers that survive the background, supersets, personal records, and 28 days of progress.

more.title: Kiosk banking
more.body: A cross-platform banking kiosk with secure sign-in, an on-screen keyboard, and several languages, packaged natively for the web, Windows, and macOS.

more.title: Real-time chat
more.body: WhatsApp-style chat over STOMP: group chats with admin approval, private messages with read receipts, typing indicators, and file sharing.

more.title: ytTheme
more.body: A calmer YouTube: hides Shorts, ads, and noise, and lays the page out in glass over your own wallpaper, with a topic and sort bar.

experience.role: Software Engineer · First Citizens Bank platform
experience.body: Same platform, team, and client, carried over from FIS Global. Backend API architecture on Java 21, Spring Boot 3.5, and Kafka in a 25+ engineer delivery team, and mentoring junior engineers on testing and CI/CD.

Spring Boot microservices across a 30+ service estate for retail, mobile, and corporate banking: maker-checker authorisation for PCI-DSS and SOX, card-on-file tokenisation for Visa and Mastercard, RFC 6238 TOTP with push approval, Video KYC, LLM banking assistants, and the ELK and Kafka observability rollout.

award: Above & Beyond Individual Award · FIS Global · Q1 2024, for critical project delivery
education: B.E. Computer Science and Engineering · Sri Siddhartha Institute of Technology · 2017 – 2021
